summary: The market keeps sliding off its morning peak and is clinging to a slim gain, with sellers active in heavyweights while midcaps hold up better than smallcaps.

detail.leaders: PSU banks, metals, oil & gas; Bajaj Finance, Shriram Finance, ITC
detail.laggards: IT, pharma, autos; HCLTech, Asian Paints, HDFC Bank
detail.tone: Weaker than the previous note: at 1 pm the Nifty was up just 0.16% at 22,458.30, and a later update put the Sensex about 700 points off its high.
watch: A break below the 22,460.80 morning low turning the day red
HDFC Bank selling spreading to other private lenders
IT and pharma weakness into the close
